composition_variation: Show Kanao Tsuyuri in an age-appropriate fully covering white cape, dark blouse, and calf-length skirt, standing within a wisteria garden. She holds an unlettered cream card loosely at waist height and looks toward the viewer with a small thoughtful smile. Use clean linework, purple watercolor washes, luminous green foliage, and a low stone path. Concentrate the flowers around the lower frame. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
